# `mysql` type mapping

Generated from [`drivers/mysql/internal/datatype_conversion.go`](https://github.com/datazip-inc/olake/blob/v1.1.2/drivers/mysql/internal/datatype_conversion.go) at `v1.1.2`. Source column type (lower-cased by the driver) to the OLake type in `available_streams.json`. A type not listed here is read as `String`. How each OLake type lands in Iceberg or Parquet: `olake-destination-abstract`.
